notes.title: Thank You for Playing the Dotu Demo!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

First off — a big THANK YOU to everyone who played the [b]Dotu [/b]demo and shared feedback with us! Your thoughts, bug reports, kind words (and dot-related confusion) have been incredibly helpful.

We’ve made a lot of progress on the game since the demo launched, and while we’re proud of how far [b]Dotu [/b]has come, we also realized… the current demo doesn’t quite represent the game anymore.

As a tiny team of two, we unfortunately don’t have the bandwidth to build a brand-new demo right now.
We’re fully focused on finishing the full game and updating the Steam page to better reflect where [b]Dotu [/b]is today.

So, we’ve decided to remove the old demo for now. It may return in a shinier, updated form in the future in the future when the time is right.

Thanks again for all your support. We can’t wait to share more of [b]Dotu [/b]with you soon!

With love and logic puzzles,
The Chicken Undercover Team 🐔

notes.title: Dotu is taking part on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445570/5165b4fabeec6e84cc1a8bef48f0076f48f9a53a.jpg[/img]

In the Steam Next Fest Demo, you will be able to play the first 28 levels of the first world giving you a sneak peek of the game.

If you find a bug or something is blocking you from enjoying [b]Dotu[/b] Demo let us know and we will try to help you as soon as possible.

And once you beat the demo don't forget to let us know what you thought about it by leaving a review on the demo page. Your feedback is super important to us!

We can't wait to show you the full game.
But for now enjoy the Demo and Thank you for playing!
